questions.stem_text:
Which of the following best describes the practice of placing the blame for the problems
of a society on one particular group?

options.A: the formation of an attachment bond between an infant and its carer
options.B: a tendency of social theorists to explain everything in terms of social causes
options.C: the process of becoming part of a society by learning its norms and values
options.D: the historical process by which societies change from traditional to modern

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - the process of becoming part of a society by learning its norms and values

options.A: a subtler form of prejudice, masked by nationalist pride
options.B: a post-modern deconstruction of racist ideas to reveal their lack of depth
options.C: racist practices found in newly emerging areas of social life, such as cyberspace
options.D: an anti-fascist movement which challenges nationalist politics

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - a subtler form of prejudice, masked by nationalist pride
